facts.fact: The notice states the Data Protection Act (No. 5 of 2022) was passed in March 2022 to provide for the collection, processing, disclosure and protection of personal information.
The notice states the Act designates the Eswatini Communications Commission as the Eswatini Data Protection Authority, and the Commission itself issues this decision under section 5(1)(y) of the Act.
EDPA Notice No. 1/2024, a final decision on registration of data controllers and processors, was issued in February 2024 under the Act and took effect on 1 March 2024.

The decision makes registration mandatory from 1 March 2024 for controllers and processors handling data of more than ten data subjects, with annual renewal and fee bands; it names no decision on a controller and gives no counts.
